messages:
Ivy: hey 👋 first week — trying to boot the local stack. `docker-compose up` spins postgres + redis but my app hits `psql: FATAL:  password authentication failed for user "postgres"`. compose uses env POSTGRES_PASSWORD and i can `docker exec -it svc_postgres psql -U postgres` no pw locally. weird.
Marco: welcome! on mac sometimes the DB was initialized earlier with a different password or trust settings. did you mount a host dir for pgdata? that can keep old creds around.
Ivy: yes `- ./pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data` because i wanted persisted dev data.
Marco: that explains it. If the data dir already has a cluster initialized, changing POSTGRES_PASSWORD won't update the existing user. Either remove the volume (if safe) or exec into the container and `psql` as the postgres unix user to alter the password: `ALTER USER postgres WITH PASSWORD 'yourpw';`.
Ivy: tried `docker exec -it postgres_container psql -U postgres` and it did drop me in with no pw, then `ALTER USER postgres WITH PASSWORD 'localpass';` fixed the auth. app now connects. thanks.
Ivy: quick followup — redis in the compose has `requirepass` set in our `redis.conf` but my node app still gets `NOAUTH Authentication required`. i set REDIS_URL=redis://:mypass@localhost:6379 but no luck.
Marco: if using redis 6+ with ACLs, `requirepass` vs configured user matters. our image uses ACLs and expects `default` user auth syntax: `redis-cli -a mypass` may work for older but for ACLs you might need `ACL SETUSER default on >mypass` when initializing, or connect with `redis://default:mypass@host:port`. Confirm what image tag you use (alpine vs official) and check `/data/redis.conf` in the container.
ops-bot: Note: repo has `dev/seed-redis.sh` that sets up ACL user `devuser` and password from `.env.dev`. Run it after redis is healthy.
Ivy: ran seed script and switched REDIS_URL to `redis://devuser:devpw@127.0.0.1:6379/0` — works.
Marco: pro tip for mac: avoid host bind mounts for Postgres unless you know the uid/gid mapping — prefer named volumes: `- pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data` and `volumes:
  pgdata:` to let docker manage permissions. also add a compose healthcheck for pg so your setup scripts wait.
DevEx: i'll add two lines to onboarding: (1) note about persisted pgdata keeping old creds and how to reset, (2) Redis ACL vs requirepass differences and example `redis://user:pass@...`.
Ivy: awesome, that's super helpful — up and running now :tada:
